events.summary: I'm happy to announce that we're working hard on the next update for the demo!Recently, I have been focusing a lot on developing the full game, and unfortunately the demo has been collecting dust for some time, and it no longer reflects the quality that we're aiming for with the full version of the game. events.title: Japanese Localization!
events.summary: We are very happy to announce that Shroud of Gloom will officially support Japanese! This is something that has been requested before, and we are delighted to finally have found a localizer to help make this possible! We are working hard to get the next demo update ready, which will have more content, new puzzles, and a lot more polish - and now we can finally say that it will be fully playable in Japanese too! A big thank you to Machiko who is helping us out with the localization, どうもありがとうございます

events.title: Breaking the Silence!
events.summary: We are proud to announce that Shroud of Gloom will feature professional voice acting! We've put a lot of effort in making sure the atmosphere and immersion is as good as possible, and we are now taking the next step - we are hiring professional voice actors to strengthen the game's atmosphere even more!
